release_notes.en-US: Hardens misleading-link detection for Amazon S3 and other shared-hosting services. The extension now compares tenant and bucket identities, recognizes additional destination cues such as secure sign-in and account-access text, detects brand impersonation on shared hosts, and limits visible-domain parsing work. Permissions, data practices, and local-only analysis are unchanged.

version.approval_notes: Version 0.1.5 is a security-hardening update for visible-domain mismatch and brand-impersonation detection. It treats Amazon S3 bucket-qualified virtual-hosted and path-style URLs as tenant identities rather than trusting the shared amazonaws.com suffix, applies tenant-aware checks to other shared-hosting services, recognizes additional destination-claim phrases, and caps visible-domain match collection at the two values required by the classifier. The popup also handles scan failures defensively. No permissions, data practices, network behavior, telemetry, or remote services changed. Analysis remains entirely on-device with declared data collection none. The repository test suite, Mozilla lint, and package build all pass.
